module.name: holoscan-image-quality
module.description: Per-frame image quality checks on the GPU, to flag frames downstream perception should not trust: blur and focus (variance of the Laplacian and Tenengrad, globally and per tile), exposure (luma mean, percentiles, clipped fractions, dynamic range), noise (MAD of a high-pass over flat pixels), frozen frames (hash and mean difference), lens obstruction (low-texture tiles over time) and color cast (gray world), as a metrics tensor, a flags bitfield, per-tile values and a HoloViz tile overlay.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.
